description.zh:
公网地址类型，可选值：
- **SRV**
- **Normal**
>当释放的连接地址是SRV地址时，本参数才可用。
description.en:
The type of the public endpoint. Valid values:

- **SRV**

- **Normal**

> This parameter is available only when the endpoint to be released is an SRV endpoint.
The ID of the sharded cluster instance.

description.zh:
该节点内网连接地址所属的网络类型，取值：
- **VPC**：专有网络。
- **Classic**：经典网络。

> 您可以调用[DescribeShardingNetworkAddress](~~62135~~)接口查询该节点的内网连接地址所属的网络类型。
description.en:
The network type of the internal endpoint for the node. Valid values:

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud.

- **Classic**: classic network.

> Call the [DescribeShardingNetworkAddress](~~62135~~) API to query the network type of the internal endpoint for the node.

description.zh:
Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~62010~~)接口查询Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的ID。
><notice>当释放srv地址时，此处填写实例ID即可。></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the shard or Configserver node.

> Call the [DescribeDBInstanceAttribute](~~62010~~) API to query the ID of the shard or Configserver node.
>
> ><notice>
>
> When you release an SRV address, enter the instance ID for this parameter.
>
> ></notice>

title.zh: 释放节点或节点内网连接地址

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口用于释放分片集群实例中Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的内网连接地址。更多信息请参见[释放Shard或ConfigServer节点连接地址](~~134067~~)。
- 如果需要释放分片集群实例中Shard节点或ConfigServer节点的公网连接地址，您可以通过调用[ReleasePublicNetworkAddress](~~67604~~)接口释放。
descriptions.en:
- This operation releases the internal endpoint of a shard or Configserver node for a sharded cluster instance. For more information, see [Release the endpoint of a shard or Configserver node](~~134067~~).

- To release the public endpoint of a shard or Configserver node for a sharded cluster instance, call the [ReleasePublicNetworkAddress](~~67604~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds release-node-private-network-address --db-instance-id dds-bp1a7009eb240000 --node-id d-bp128a0034360000 --network-type VPC --connection-type SRV --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds ReleaseNodePrivateNetworkAddress --region cn-hangzhou --ConnectionType SRV --DBInstanceId 'dds-bp1a7009eb240000' --NetworkType VPC --NodeId 'd-bp128a0034360000'
